title: T-Mobile Logo Don’ts
slide_intent: Make damaging alterations visible so contributors can recognize when a mark has lost consistency.
strategic_value: A shared misuse checklist can protect the recognizable shape and relationships of T-Mobile marks.

practical_value: Compare a proposed use against the specific failure examples before production.
